records.text: Victor Marx says a Homeland Security Investigations trafficking specialist approved bringing Holly Chalmers from Canada into the United States with temporary status, after which his team brought in law enforcement and documented the arrangement.
records.speaker: Victor Marx

appearances.snippet: Two, we met with an HSI human trafficking specialist at the border who approved us to get through from Canada to the U.S. and gave her temporary status. ... Three, we brought in law enforcement both here and in Texas where we were keeping her, before we documented everything, and five, the very point couple in Canada that was our, I would say our agents of hope up there, have video that they just posted yesterday of Holly (Holly Chalmers) telling the truth about.

verification.notes: The current El Paso County case file documents the broader Chalmers travel dispute but does not establish that an HSI specialist authorized entry or granted temporary status. No HSI, CBP, or other federal record confirming that asserted border arrangement was located.

records.text: Owens said a federal HSI whistleblower case alleged personnel received video evidence in April of 2020 potentially implicating David Levitt in trafficking and Indian child welfare violations but did not investigate; she explicitly said there was no criminal finding against him.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: So I find that to be remarkably suspicious. Then there was that in 2020, there was a federal HSI whistleblower case where an HSI analyst alleged that personnel received video evidence in April of 2020, potentially implicating Levitt (David O. Levitt; former Utah County attorney, surname spelling unverified) in violations of federal trafficking and Indian child welfare laws, but they ultimately failed to open an investigation. ... There was no criminal finding against Levitt (David O. Levitt; former Utah County attorney, surname spelling unverified). Then the big one that I was just telling you about, which involved cannibalism, in May and June of 2022, there was a ritual child ritual abuse investigation.
